executions.no_program: Build committed no adversarial probe program for this change: it is a two-check early-exit guard in ProcessVideo whose boundary cases (dry-run, already-processed, force bypass, handle-mismatch fallback) are covered by the RED→GREEN unit tests TestProcessVideo_EarlySkip and TestExtractHandleFromURL in pipeline/pipeline_test.go

findings.text: nitpick: TestExtractHandleFromURL tests the unexported extractHandleFromURL directly; per the lens, a new test calling an internal (non-entry) function whose behaviour is reachable from the module entry is a placement finding — the URL-form behaviour is observable through ProcessVideo via channelCfg.URL.
findings.fix: Fold the URL-form cases into TestProcessVideo_EarlySkip as channelCfg.URL cases, then delete TestExtractHandleFromURL.

findings.text: nitpick: the parameter is named url, shadowing the net/url package that this same file imports and uses at pipeline.go:1558; a future url.Parse inside this function would fail confusingly.
findings.fix: Rename the parameter to rawURL (or channelURL) in the signature, body, and test call sites.

findings.text: nitpick: regexp.MustCompile runs inside extractHandleFromURL on every call, recompiling a fixed pattern once per video in a scan — a needless cost in a change whose whole purpose is scan speed.
findings.fix: Hoist to a package-level var (var handleRe = regexp.MustCompile(`/(@[^/]+)`)) and reference it from the function.

findings.text: nitpick (non-blocking): TestExtractHandleFromURL calls the unexported extractHandleFromURL, whose behaviour is reachable from the module entry ProcessVideo via channelCfg.URL, so the parser's rejection forms (/channel/UC…, /c/…, /user/…) are asserted only at the internal seam and no entry-level test proves a handle-less config URL skips the early check and falls through to a fetch.
findings.fix: Add one entry-level case to TestProcessVideo_EarlySkip whose channelCfg.URL is e.g. https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC1234567890abcdef, asserting the video is not skipped by the early check and FetchVideoMeta is called exactly once, then delete TestExtractHandleFromURL.

findings.text: nitpick (non-blocking): the parameter `url string` shadows the imported net/url package (still used elsewhere in this file at pipeline.go:1558), so any future url.* call inside the function silently binds the string parameter.
findings.fix: Rename the parameter to `channelURL` (or `rawURL`) in the signature and the two body references.
